configuration.candidate_structure: On rows with a finite NM clock, 50% new global and 50% new LightGBM airport models. CatBoost uses the already fitted airport models of the matching target formulation. V5 is retained exactly where both NM clocks are missing. All candidate/v5 weights are common across folds and airports.
configuration.prior_evidence: Declared after v5 and the aggregate gain review. Only the original full-data arithmetic NM proxy audit exists; no new NM-clock model or complete validation score was inspected before this declaration. Earlier generic missing-NM and stand/runway models failed promotion. No held-out-ID-specific rules are introduced.
configuration.refit_iterations: Rounded median of the two October-selected counts for every selected global and airport component. New clock nodes fit only the clock-available route. All January-November rows remain represented by the pipeline, with December flight groups excluded.
configuration.selection: Eight development runs: direct and NM-residual targets with LightGBM and CatBoost on both original folds. Forty-four new LightGBM native fits and four new CatBoost fits. Five families mixed with v5 at 25/50/75/100 percent, twenty recipes. Require at least 0.5 percent lower complete RMSE on both folds and minimize their equally weighted mean RMSE ratio. No airport-specific weight tuning.
